what: PAIRS-ALPACA-BUILD review item 4 (INFERRED from code): accepted is not filled for a pairs leg. AlpacaClient.place polls ALPACA_PLACE_CONFIRM_S (default 3s) and refuses an order that goes rejected/canceled/expired INSIDE that window, so a fast async reject is caught and the leg-imbalance unwind runs. NOT caught: (a) a reject/cancel AFTER the window, (b) a PARTIAL fill -- execute_pkg journals the requested whole-share qty, so the two legs' filled ratio can drift from the hedge with nothing comparing them. Fix candidates: after both legs are sent, read each leg's order status/filled_qty (account_order_status) on the next tick and either top up/trim or unwind; or compare venue position qty vs journal per leg each decision.
